overall_narrative_summary: Full text of the target study (Robina Ramirez & Sanudo-Fontaneda 2018, 'Human Aspects of Water Management at Impoverished Settlements. The Case of Doornkop, Soweto', Water) is not accessible due to a DOI/PDF retrieval mismatch. Although the record header lists DOI 10.3390/w10030312 and retrieval status retrieved_oa_pdf, that DOI and the provided 12-page source text actually belong to an unrelated hydrological engineering article: Wang, Qu, Chen, Li, & Gu (2018), 'A 60-Minute Design Rainstorm for the Urban Area of Yangpu District, Shanghai, China' (Water 2018, 10, 312). Per review protocol, study design and risk-of-bias ratings are never guessed from a citation or title; accordingly, paper_read is set to 'not accessible', chosen_tool and overall_rating are set to 'cannot_tell', and all cross-tool domains are set to 'cannot_tell' pending retrieval of the correct Doornkop, Soweto full text during reconciliation. (For completeness, if evaluated strictly on the mis-retrieved Wang et al. 2018 text itself, that paper is a pure statistical hydrology/hyetograph derivation using rain-gauge records from three Shanghai stations with no human subjects, legal/institutional exposure, or water-access outcome, which would map to 'NONE'.)
